cards.title: Why it works
items: The verifier is a different seat that trusts none of the builder's claims — machine-checked, not self-attested
The run branches ON the verdict: verified lands behind a human gate, failed escalates with the ladder empty
Both arms converge on a single closeout paragraph the owner skims first

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes: build -> independent verify -> {{branches}}-way route -> land_gate | escalate, joined at closeout
No retry loop ships here: a failed attempt reaches the owner, not another silent build
